safe_review_note: Manual Expert Review is a triage and evidence-review workflow. It helps confirm scanner findings, remove false positives, collect missing evidence, and prepare a reviewed pre-audit readiness report. It is not a certified audit, does not guarantee all vulnerabilities are found, and does not replace a professional security review.
